Because the pool is not an independent biological replicate and has no chemostat dilution rate, the contract-correct values are pooled and not applicable respectively in all 60 expanded reference rows.

claims.value: Trypsin; 5 ppm; 0.6 Da; fixed Methylthio(C); variable Oxidation(M); fixed TMT6plex(K and peptide N-terminus)
claims.evidence: These values are stated in the accession's sample-processing and Proteome Discoverer/Mascot data-processing protocols.

claims.value: higher energy beam-type collision-induced dissociation; MS:1002481
claims.evidence: The PRIDE data-processing protocol states that reporter ions were identified in MS3 HCD spectra, supporting the specific HCD PSI-MS term and accession.

limitations: The deposit does not name a separate reporter-ion product variant; UNIMOD:737 is used for the documented fixed TMT chemistry, while exact channel identities are taken from sampleinfo.docx.

The reference pool is not one of the 12 chemostat samples and has no experimental dilution rate; its factor value[dilution rate] is therefore the explicit contract-valid placeholder 'not applicable' rather than an empty cell.
Sparse, unused channels are absent from the final SDRF; they were explicitly declared only in the build input so no source-to-channel assignment was invented.
